hooks.text: 三十余英雄卡按职业定位组建阵型
hooks.excerpt: This is a pixel-style card game with over 30 hero cards for you to choose from. Each hero card has its own unique skill, including warriors, mages, supports, controllers, tanks, and various other types. The selection of different characters builds diverse battle formations, bringing you a unique experience!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 七类基础装备合成衍生五十余种
hooks.excerpt: With 7 basic equipment types, the rich synthesis upgrade system can derive over 50+ types of equipment. Rich equipment combined with variously positioned hero cards makes lineup construction more flexible!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 药水与卷轴构成额外战术工具池
hooks.excerpt: There is also a potion and scroll system to assist you in your journey! There are 8 potions and over 20 scrolls for you to use. The rational use of potions and scrolls will achieve unexpected effects!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

baseline.message: 首期基线，暂无可比趋势。

risks: 截至2026-07-24，Steam官方评论数少于20条，市场验证规模仍小。

actions.label: 原型验证
actions.reason: 产品处于正式分池且已有官方与客观材料，但缺少可直接采用的人工确认正向观点。
actions.trigger: 补充玩家证据或完成轻量原型验证后更新优先级。
